about: How each of Orsino's wonders whose effect Kyr can run (orsino-world.json) stands in a generated country: in the wild country or within a work; what it is called when pointed at; how it looks before anyone meets it; how it is approached; what happens to whoever does; and how it is after. Written by hand: Orsino gives a wonder's description and effect, not what it is to meet one.

ancient_trees.name: the great tree
ancient_trees.seen: A tree far older than the country round it stands alone here, its roots heaved up out of the ground like the backs of sleeping animals. Close to, the bark seems to move, very slowly, as if it breathed.
ancient_trees.taken: The bark is warm. Something slow and green comes up out of the roots and through your palm, and old hurts close.
ancient_trees.after: The great tree stands as trees stand. Whatever answered your hand is asleep in it again.

arcane_clock.name: the clock
arcane_clock.seen: A clock stands against the wall, taller than a man, its face marked with more hours than a day has. The hand moves, stops, and goes back a little.
arcane_clock.taken: The key turns once. The clock runs backwards a little, and then you are moving faster than the dust falls.
arcane_clock.after: The clock has stopped at no hour you know.

arcane_symbols.name: the glowing symbols
arcane_symbols.seen: Symbols are cut into the stone in rows, and a light moves along them groove by groove, slow as a pulse.
arcane_symbols.taken: Your finger follows the lines, and the pulse in them goes up your arm; the room goes very sharp and clear.
arcane_symbols.after: The symbols are only cut stone now, dark in their grooves.

arcane_well.name: the well
arcane_well.seen: A well stands out here with no house near it, its curb worn smooth. The water is a long way down, and smells of rain that has not fallen here.
arcane_well.taken: The water is colder than any water here and tastes of somewhere else. Your hurts ease as it goes down.
arcane_well.after: The well is dry to the bottom, as if it had only been waiting for one drink.

celestial_fountain.name: the fountain
celestial_fountain.seen: A fountain plays in a stone basin, and the water coming out of it is full of light, as if it had been out under the sun all day.
celestial_fountain.taken: The water is full of light. It goes down like a warm hand and stays round you like a cloak.
celestial_fountain.after: The basin holds only rainwater now.

celestial_glow.name: the glow
celestial_glow.seen: A light lies on the ground here that has nothing to do with the sky: soft, pale, and the shape of a door laid flat.
celestial_glow.taken: The light is on you like weather. Where it touches, your skin goes hard and faintly scaled, like a fish's.
celestial_glow.after: The glow has gone up out of the place, and the light here is ordinary light.

celestial_map.name: the star map
celestial_map.seen: A map is painted over the wall and the ceiling: stars, and the lines between them, and countries that are on no map of this world.
celestial_map.taken: The stars on it are not ours. One of them burns as you look, and you understand how: you could call that burning down.
celestial_map.after: The map is faded paint, its stars only gilt.

celestial_observatory.name: the star-glass
celestial_observatory.seen: A brass tube as long as a boat lies on a stand under an opening in the roof, pointed at one piece of sky.
celestial_observatory.taken: Through the glass the sky is close and full of falling stones, and you learn the way of bringing them down.
celestial_observatory.after: The glass is cracked across and shows nothing.

color_shifts.name: the shifting colours
color_shifts.seen: The heather here is the wrong colour, and then another wrong colour: the ground goes slowly through shades no plant has, and back.
color_shifts.taken: The colours wash over you, and after them acid and light and worse seem things that would slide off you.
color_shifts.after: The colours have gone out of the place and left it its own.

dancing_lights.name: the dancing lights
dancing_lights.seen: Small lights move over the ground in twos and threes, weaving round one another, as if dancing to something you cannot hear.
dancing_lights.taken: You go after them, stepping where they step, and when they go out you are lighter on your feet than you have ever been.
dancing_lights.after: There are no lights now, only the place.

eerie_chimes.name: the chimes
eerie_chimes.seen: Someone has hung chimes of thin metal from a dead tree, and when the wind moves them they ring notes that belong to no tune.
eerie_chimes.taken: There is no wind, and still they ring. The sound goes into you and smooths you down.
eerie_chimes.after: The chimes hang still and do not ring.

enchanted_aura.name: the shimmer
enchanted_aura.seen: Over a ring of ground here the air shimmers like air over a fire, though it is cold. Nothing grows inside it, and nothing has trodden it.
enchanted_aura.taken: The air shimmers on your skin and stays there, a thin bright skin over your own that blows and spells will slide off.
enchanted_aura.after: The shimmer has gone out of the air.

enchanted_flute.name: the flute
enchanted_flute.seen: A flute of pale wood lies on a shelf by itself, with no dust on it, though there is dust on everything else.
enchanted_flute.taken: You have never played, but the flute knows how. The tune goes on in you after you have put it down.
enchanted_flute.after: The flute is a split old reed, and will not sound.

enchanted_grove.name: the grove
enchanted_grove.seen: Birches stand here in a ring too regular to have grown that way, and the air inside it is warmer than the air outside.
enchanted_grove.taken: You sit among the trees, and the hum of them goes into you; when you stand, your hurts have closed.
enchanted_grove.after: The grove is only trees, and quiet.

enchanted_statue_garden.name: the statues
enchanted_statue_garden.seen: Statues fill the court: men and women in old dress, standing as if caught in the middle of something. Look away and back, and one of them is nearer.
enchanted_statue_garden.taken: They turn their heads after you. When you have passed the last one you know how they were made, and how to make more.
enchanted_statue_garden.after: The statues are only statues, and they do not turn.

enchanted_statues.name: the statue
enchanted_statues.seen: A statue of a woman stands here with one hand held out. Each time you look, the hand is held a little higher.
enchanted_statues.taken: The stone hand closes on yours, and stone runs up your arm under the skin and stays there, a ward and a shield.
enchanted_statues.after: The statue's hand is open, and does not close.

eternal_candle.name: the candle
eternal_candle.seen: A candle burns in a niche, its flame quite steady, its wax not run at all. There is no smoke.
eternal_candle.taken: The flame leans to you, and after it light itself seems a thing that cannot hurt you.
eternal_candle.after: The candle has gone out, and the wick is cold.

ethereal_fountain.name: the fountain
ethereal_fountain.seen: Water runs here into a basin that never fills, so clear it is hard to see where it stops and the air begins.
ethereal_fountain.taken: The water is from somewhere else, and it heals like nothing from here.
ethereal_fountain.after: The fountain has stopped. Its basin is dry.

ethereal_music.name: the music
ethereal_music.seen: A tune comes from nowhere you can find, low and sad, played on something with strings. It stops when you stop walking.
ethereal_music.taken: You stand still and the tune finds you, and puts heart into you.
ethereal_music.after: There is no music now, only the wind.

floating_disk.name: the floating disk
floating_disk.seen: A disk of grey stone, wide as a cartwheel, hangs a hand's breadth off the floor, turning slowly.
floating_disk.taken: It takes your weight and lifts, and when you step off you do not quite come down.
floating_disk.after: The disk lies on the floor, a plate of dull metal.

floating_lights.name: the floating lights
floating_lights.seen: Lights the size of a fist hang in the air here, a dozen of them, drifting in and out of one another's paths.
floating_lights.taken: The lights close round your head and go out one by one, and after them your mind is shut like a box: nothing gets in.

glowing_crystals.name: the crystal
glowing_crystals.seen: A crystal as long as a forearm stands in a cleft of the wall, glowing from inside, like a lamp seen through a hand.
glowing_crystals.taken: It warms in your hand and the glow goes into you, and you see three ways round everything.
glowing_crystals.after: The crystal is dull glass now.

glowing_pool.name: the pool
glowing_pool.seen: A pool lies in the rocks here, and the water in it glows a soft green-white, brightest at the bottom.
glowing_pool.taken: The water glows round you, and where it touches, hurts close as if they had never been.
glowing_pool.after: The pool is dark water, only water.

glowing_runes.name: the runes
glowing_runes.seen: Runes are cut round the doorway, and they glow one after another, as if someone were reading them aloud very slowly.
glowing_runes.taken: You cannot read them, and then you can. They tell you nothing you could say again, but you see more after.

illusory_visions.name: the visions
illusory_visions.seen: At the edge of your sight there are people: a woman at a well, a man with a dog, children running. Look straight at them and they are not there.
illusory_visions.taken: At the edge of sight there are people who are not here. You look at them straight, and they show you what is clear and what is wise.
illusory_visions.after: There is nothing at the edge of sight now.

levitating_objects.name: the floating things
levitating_objects.seen: Things hang in the air of this room as if the floor had been taken out from under them: a cup, a stool, a shoe, a key, all turning slowly.
levitating_objects.taken: Cups, stones and an old shoe turn in the air round your arm. When you draw it back it moves as lightly as they do.
levitating_objects.after: Everything that floated lies on the floor where it fell.

living_book.name: the book
living_book.seen: A book lies open on a stand, and the writing on its page is being written, a line at a time, in a careful hand, with no one holding the pen.
living_book.taken: The book writes while you read it, and what it writes is how to call the lightning.
living_book.after: The pages are blank, and stay blank.

living_mural.name: the mural
living_mural.seen: A painted wall shows a valley with people in it at work, and the people move, a little, whenever you look away.
living_mural.taken: The painted people move faster the longer you watch, and you learn how they do it.
living_mural.after: The paint is flaking and still.

magical_fountain.name: the fountain
magical_fountain.seen: A fountain runs into a stone basin here, and the water has a shine on it, like oil, in every colour.
magical_fountain.taken: The water fizzes on your tongue and goes through you like strong drink, closing hurts as it goes.

magical_lantern.name: the lantern
magical_lantern.seen: A lantern hangs from a hook, lit, though no one has filled it. Whatever its light falls on looks more like itself.
magical_lantern.taken: Its light goes over you and shows something written on your skin, a ward, that fades but does not go.
magical_lantern.after: The lantern is cold and empty.

magical_sundial.name: the sundial
magical_sundial.seen: A sundial stands here under the roof, where no sun can reach it, and its shadow moves anyway.
magical_sundial.taken: The shadow on it moves as you watch, quick as a hand, and you are quick with it.
magical_sundial.after: The shadow on the dial lies where any shadow would.

magical_weather.name: the strange weather
magical_weather.seen: Over one stretch of ground here the weather is its own: a small cloud that rains on it, and only on it, whatever the sky round about is doing.
magical_weather.taken: Rain, then hail, then heat, then lightning, all in a breath and all on you, and none of it harms you; nor will it for a while.
magical_weather.after: The weather here is only the country's weather.

mystical_fog.name: the fog
mystical_fog.seen: A fog lies in the hollow here and does not lift, whatever the wind does. It moves, though, slowly, as if it were looking for something.
mystical_fog.taken: The fog closes round you and goes into you. When you come out of it you shine a little, as if you were someone.

oathstone_circle.name: the stone circle
oathstone_circle.seen: Nine stones stand here in a ring, none higher than a man's waist. The grass inside it is greener, and nobody has left anything in it.
oathstone_circle.taken: You say the words, and the stones hear them. The oath sits in you like a stone and holds you up.
oathstone_circle.after: The stones stand. The oath does not need them now.

phantom_flame.name: the cold flame
phantom_flame.seen: A flame stands in the air in the middle of the room, with nothing under it and nothing for it to burn.
phantom_flame.taken: It does not burn. After it, you doubt any fire would.
phantom_flame.after: The cold flame has gone out.

phantom_garden.name: the pale flowers
phantom_garden.seen: Flowers grow here that grow nowhere else in the country: tall, white, and very still, as if someone had set them out for a guest.
phantom_garden.taken: The flowers are cold to the touch and smell of nothing, and every step among them closes a hurt.
phantom_garden.after: The flowers have fallen; there is only grass.

shifting_walls.name: the shifting wall
shifting_walls.seen: The walls of this room are not quite where they were. Count the stones along one side, and count again, and the number is different.
shifting_walls.taken: The wall moves under your hand, and something of its stone moves into you: your skin is hard as iron.

shimmering_veil.name: the veil
shimmering_veil.seen: A veil of light hangs between two rocks here like a sheet put out to dry, and through it the country beyond looks a little different.
shimmering_veil.taken: For a breath you are somewhere else, and you come back marked with a ward you cannot see.
shimmering_veil.after: There is no veil, only air.

singing_crystal.name: the singing crystal
singing_crystal.seen: A crystal grows out of the rock here, tall and clear, and hums very faintly, the way a glass does when a wet finger goes round its rim.
singing_crystal.taken: It sings when you touch it, a long high note that stays in you and lifts your heart.

spectral_figures.name: the grey figures
spectral_figures.seen: Figures go by here in a line, grey and silent, walking somewhere. They take no notice of you. You can see the hill through them.
spectral_figures.taken: They go before you without a sound and turn once to look at you, and you carry yourself after it like someone who has been looked at.

time_dilation.name: the slow place
time_dilation.seen: On a stretch of ground here the grass bends to a wind you cannot feel, and the clouds over it go faster than clouds anywhere else.
time_dilation.taken: The world outside slows to a crawl. When you step out, you keep a little of the quickness.
time_dilation.after: Time runs here as it runs everywhere.

unearthly_silence.name: the silence
unearthly_silence.seen: A silence lies over this place that is more than quiet. Your own footsteps sound far off, and then not at all.
unearthly_silence.taken: No sound, not even your own heart. You stand in it until your mind is still and clear.
unearthly_silence.after: There are birds again, and wind.

whispering_voices.name: the whispering wall
whispering_voices.seen: Voices whisper in the walls here, too low to make out, as if a roomful of people were talking next door. There is no next door.
whispering_voices.taken: The voices tell you things old people know, and now you know them too.
